title: The Effect of Telerehabilitation of Patients With Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to investigate the effect of a telerehabilitation approach to patients with Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy and evaluate patients' motor function, parents' anxiety and depression levels before and after the intervention
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with Duchenne muscular dystrophy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients without the ability of independent ambulation
